title: 花旗ECM联席主管：数据中心IPO窗口未关，但估值逻辑正在调整
speaker: Unknown (Citi Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets)

segments.en: We've been talking about data centers, right? Given what we saw from Ellis yesterday. This is not really a well known company.
segments.zh: 我们一直在谈论数据中心，对吧？鉴于昨天Ellis的情况。这并非一家广为人知的公司。

segments.en: It could still send shivers across the AI space here right now. Then you had the likes of firmness just a few weeks ago pulling that IPO in Australia and really looking maybe at the US market.
segments.zh: 它仍可能在当前人工智能领域引发震动。几周前，类似Firmness的公司撤回了在澳大利亚的IPO，可能真正着眼的是美国市场。

segments.en: How should I be looking at the window for data center IPOs now? Is that window closing? I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我现在应如何看待数据中心IPO的窗口？这个窗口正在关闭吗？我不这么认为。

segments.en: I think this is certainly a time of a degree of caution. And I think what investors are really saying here is that they want to look at assets from a differentiated basis.
segments.zh: 我认为当前无疑是一个需要一定谨慎的时期。投资者真正想表达的是，他们希望以差异化的方式审视资产。

segments.en: They want to look at each story in of itself. Who has the contracts, who has the credibility, who has the track record, who has the development in place, and all of that.
segments.zh: 他们希望逐一审视每个故事本身。谁拥有合同、谁具备可信度、谁有业绩记录、谁已有开发项目落地，等等。

segments.en: And I think it might be an adjustment that we'll have over the next few weeks, which will settle out from a valuation perspective at a different level slightly to what we had maybe three months ago.
segments.zh: 我认为未来几周可能会出现一轮调整，从估值角度看，最终会稳定在略不同于三个月前的水平。

segments.en: I think the capital raising activity will remain. It may take different forms. And we've seen the news on firmness today with Nvidia as well.
segments.zh: 我认为资本募集活动将会持续，可能采取不同形式。我们今天也看到了Firmness与英伟达相关的消息。

segments.en: So plenty of aspects of capital raising that could be via strategics, that could be via the private markets, that could be via IPOs as well.
segments.zh: 因此资本募集有很多途径，可以通过战略合作、私募市场，也可以通过IPO。

segments.en: I think all of those routes remain available. The question is where do we settle out from a valuation perspective? Right.
segments.zh: 我认为所有这些路径仍然可行。问题在于，从估值角度看，我们最终会稳定在什么水平？对。
